newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GRAHAM RECEIVES WORLD CUP CALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRAHAM RECEIVES WORLD CUP CALL.

text.p: Queens Park Rangers defender Mark Graham received his first Northern Ireland call-up on Monday.
He made the squad for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Albania after the withdrawal of Southampton's injured midfielder Jim Magilton.
Magilton himself was only summoned hours earlier after Anton Rogan, Danny Griffin and Nigel Worthington pulled out because of injuries.
Manager Bryan Hamilton also summoned St Johnstone striker George O'Boyle.
